name: Commercial Metals Company
summary: Commercial Metals Company manufactures, recycles, and fabricates steel and metal products, and related materials and services in the United States, Poland, China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Steel Group, Construction Solutions Group, and Europe Steel Group. The company processes and sells ferrous and nonferrous scrap metals. It also offers finished long steel products, including reinforcing bars, merchant bars, light structural and other special sections, and wire rods, as well as semi-finished billets for rerolling and forging applications.
